root_text: In the trial that tested the RSV-hMPV vaccine, three of 27 vaccinated infants later became seriously ill from hMPV infections versus none in the placebo group. 5/

nodes.text: An RSV vaccine trial in the 1960s infamously sent 80% of vaccinated children to the hospital; 2 died. Vaccine primed their immune system so that during an infection helpful T cell responses were blunted & high levels of ineffective antibodies were formed 6/ https://t.co/ZAr6i8NiYW

nodes.author: CjPerrell
nodes.text: @vipintukur So basically a repeat finding similar to the  older study?

nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text:
That tragedy “cast a decades-long shadow” over RSV vaccine development.
That shadow has been receding over past few years, as Moderna & GSK brought RSV vaccines for older adults & Pfizer developed one for pregnant women that protect infants also for first 6 months of life 7/ https://t.co/nFKapZRbWG
